data.title: Does the 40-character limit in C-event-log §1 cover the slug or the whole id?
data.question: C-event-log §1 says "slug ... ≤ 40 characters in total" and the regex has no length. Is the limit on the slug after "<letter>-" (id ≤ 42) or on the whole id (≤ 40)?

options.tradeoff: Matches the wording 'slug: ... ≤ 40'. Ids can be up to 42 characters.
Simpler to state, but 'T-' takes 2 of the 40 characters.

context.summary: The store validates ids before using them in paths. It currently enforces slug-only (internal/store/files/validate.go, maxSlugLen). T-core validates ids too, and the two must agree. Clarifying the wording is enough; no data changes.
